basic_details.job_title: SSG Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 15 TGT, Counsellor and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Sainik School Gopalganj, Bihar, is filling 15 posts: TGT (General Science), TGT (Computer Science), Counsellor, Band Master, Ward Boy and General Employee, with pay from Rs 21060 per month (consolidated) for General Employee up to 7th CPC Level-7 (Basic Pay 44,900) for the TGT posts. The educational requirement starts at Matriculation for the Ward Boy and General Employee posts. Applications are made on the prescribed format available at www.ssgopalganj.in, and the hard copy must reach the school by 31 December 2026.

application_fee.details: The fee is non-refundable. The notice asks for a crossed Bank draft drawn in favour of Principal, Sainik School Gopalganj, payable at State Bank of India, Sasamusa Branch (Code-006024), Dist-Gopalganj, Bihar. It also says application fees be paid online only using SBI Collect, and that the online payment receipt must be attached to the application.

how_to_apply: Take the prescribed application format from the school website, www.ssgopalganj.in.
Attach self-attested copies of certificates and testimonials mentioning percentage from Matriculation onwards.
Attach a passport size photograph and a bio-data including telephone/mobile number and email ID.
Attach the crossed Bank draft of Rs 500 (Gen/OBC) or Rs 400 (SC/ST) as described under the fee section.

For the online fee payment, go to the school website, click the PAY ONLINE button at the bottom left side of the home page and follow the instructions. Attach the online payment receipt to the application.

Make sure the hard copy reaches Sainik School Gopalganj, PO-Sipaya via Kuchaikote, Distt-Gopalganj (Bihar)-841 501, by 31 December 2026. The notice does not print a separate address for sending applications; this is the address on the school's letterhead.
The school's telephone number is 06156-295114 and its email, as printed on the notice, is [email protected].
important_instructions: The school will not be responsible for any postal delay, and applications received after the due date will not be considered. Sainik Schools Society Rules and Regulations, as amended from time to time, will be applicable. Age relaxation will be applicable as per Central Govt rules. The school administration reserves the right to cancel the vacancy/recruitment process or increase or decrease vacancies due to any administrative/policy reasons.

content_sections.heading: About the School
content_sections.text: Sainik School Gopalganj is located at PO-Sipaya via Kuchaikote, Distt-Gopalganj (Bihar)-841 501. Its notice is signed by the Principal, and it states that Sainik Schools Society Rules and Regulations, as amended from time to time, apply to the recruitment.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 15 vacancies across six posts. The category shown against each post is as printed in the notice. The school reserves the right to cancel the vacancy or recruitment process, or to increase or decrease vacancies, for administrative or policy reasons.

rows.category_gender_as_printed: Male/Female; UN-03, OBC-2, SC-1 and ST-1

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Age for every post is counted as on 01 April 2027. The TGT and Counsellor posts have an age limit of 21-35 years. Band Master, Ward Boy and General Employee are open to candidates between 18 and 50 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Central Govt rules; the notice does not list the relaxation categories. Essential qualification, as printed: Four years integrated degree course from an NCTE recognized university with at least 50% marks in the graduation subject combination of Botany, Zoology and Chemistry as well as in the aggregate, including B.Ed. component. OR Bachelors/Honours Degree from a recognized university with at least 50% marks in the graduation subject combination of Botany, Zoology and Chemistry, and also in aggregate, AND B.Ed. Degree from an NCTE recognized Institution/University with at least 50% marks. OR Three years Integrated B.Ed-M.Ed. from an NCTE recognized Institution/University with at least 50% marks. OR One year B.Ed. (Special Education) from Rehabilitation Council of India (RCI) with at least 50% marks. Qualified in the Central Teacher Eligibility Test (Paper-II) conducted by the Govt of India. Competence to teach through English and Hindi Medium. Essential qualification, as printed: B.Sc. Computer Science/BCA/Bachelor of Information Technology. OR Graduate Degree in any subject with Mathematics as a subject and 3 years Diploma in Computer Engineering/IT from any institution recognized by AICTE/University. OR Graduate Degree in any subject with Mathematics as a subject and at least one year Diploma in Computer Application from an Institution recognized by AICTE/University. OR 'A' Level from DOEACC. AND Bachelor of Education (B.Ed) from an institution recognized by NCTE. Desirable: proficiency in Games/Sports and other extracurricular activities/hobbies. Essential qualification, as printed: Master's/Bachelor's in Psychology (Clinical/Counselling/Applied/Educational). OR Master's in Social Work (Mental Health/Counseling). OR Bachelor's/Master's in any subject + Diploma in School Counseling/Child Guidance and Counseling. For General Employee, qualification and experience in trade will be given due weightage. Candidates should check the official notice for the exact wording of each post's qualification.

rows.essential_qualification: Potential Band Master/Band Major/Drum Major course at AEC Training and Centre, Pachmarhi. Equivalent Naval and Air Force courses.
Should have passed Matriculation or equivalent examination and should be able to converse fluently in English.

rows.desirable: Trades: Cook, DG Set Mechanic, Vehicle Mechanic, Painter, Carpenter, Mason, Cobbler, Barber, Mess Attendant, Electrician, Plumber, Sweeper etc.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Sainik School Gopalganj Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Take the prescribed application format from the school website, www.ssgopalganj.in . Attach self-attested copies of certificates and testimonials mentioning percentage from Matriculation onwards. Attach a passport size photograph and a bio-data including telephone/mobile number and email ID. Attach the crossed Bank draft of Rs 500 (Gen/OBC) or Rs 400 (SC/ST) as described under the fee section. For the online fee payment, go to the school website, click the PAY ONLINE button at the bottom left side of the home page and follow the instructions. Attach the online payment receipt to the application. Make sure the hard copy reaches Sainik School Gopalganj, PO-Sipaya via Kuchaikote, Distt-Gopalganj (Bihar)-841 501, by 31 December 2026. The notice does not print a separate address for sending applications; this is the address on the school's letterhead. The school's telephone number is 06156-295114 and its email, as printed on the notice, is [email protected] .

No TA/DA is admissible for attending the recruitment process for these posts. The notice does not describe the stages of the recruitment process or give any interview or test date.

Sainik Schools Society Rules and Regulations, as amended from time to time, will be applicable. Age relaxation will be applicable as per Central Govt rules. The school administration reserves the right to cancel the vacancy/recruitment process or increase or decrease vacancies due to any administrative/policy reasons.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Sainik School Gopalganj Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 15 vacancies: TGT (General Science) 1, TGT (Computer Science) 1, Counsellor 1, Band Master 1, Ward Boy 4 and General Employee 7.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications in hard copy at Sainik School Gopalganj is 31 December 2026. Applications received after the due date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: TGT (General Science), TGT (Computer Science) and Counsellor: 21-35 years. Band Master, Ward Boy and General Employee: between 18 and 50 years. All are counted as on 01 April 2027, and relaxation is as per Central Govt rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for each post?
faq.answer: TGT posts: as per 7th CPC Level-7 (Basic Pay 44,900/-. Counsellor: Rs 42,000/- pm. Band Master: Rs 34,000/- pm. Ward Boy: Rs 23,500/- pm. General Employee: Rs 21060/- pm. The four contractual posts are paid a consolidated amount.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs 500 for Gen/OBC and Rs 400 for SC/ST, and it is non-refundable. It is paid by crossed bank draft, and the notice also says the fee be paid online only using SBI Collect, with the receipt attached.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply on the prescribed format available on www.ssgopalganj.in. Send it in hard copy with self-attested certificates, testimonials, a photograph, a bio-data and the fee proof, so that it reaches the school by 31 December 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Only short-listed candidates will be called for the recruitment process, and selection will be carried out purely on a merit basis.

faq.question: Q8. Can a Matriculation pass candidate apply?
faq.answer: Yes, for Ward Boy and General Employee. Ward Boy needs a Matriculation or equivalent pass and fluent English conversation. General Employee needs Matriculation or equivalent.

faq.question: Q9. Which posts are contractual?
faq.answer: Counsellor, Band Master, Ward Boy and General Employee are marked Contractual in the notice, with consolidated monthly pay. The notice does not mark the two TGT posts as contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Is travel allowance given for attending the recruitment process?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA will be admissible for attending the recruitment process for these posts.
